learning.lesson: Arm attribution survives a nonce failure: read attempts[] (rank/provider/model/exit/seconds/nonce_present) before writing any 'the served arm is unprovable' finding — the nonce gates completion attestation, not attribution.

A verification turn must have its ARM RANK BOUND at dispatch (--force-rank with --max-candidates 1), then assert required_arm == served_arm in the receipt; otherwise a declared fallback can serve the check silently while every label still names the mandated model.

check_drift == [] proves projection agreement only; conformance also requires reading the file's own declared_conflicts/notes and the owner's pool. Quote which of the three surfaces disagrees rather than reporting 'drift'.
Search the openspec changes directory before preparing an owner action: the identical rebind was already proposed, so the deliverable was a citation plus a new measurement, not a second proposal.
A round that withdraws or recalibrates its own earlier claims must carry those corrections in the same change, or its ledger only ever grows.
Measure a skill's size with the GOVERNED measure (LF-normalized len) and report bytes alongside it; a byte threshold is not the platform's threshold.

Before dispatching a checker to re-run a test pair, check whether those fixtures spawn a git repository or write outside an allowed root; if they do, either allow the specific verb or state in the brief that the pair will be UNVERIFIABLE and why — otherwise the checker burns its budget proving it cannot run them.
Verify the paths a brief hands to a checker actually exist before dispatch; a path typo costs a claim's verifiability (the checker correctly refused to substitute silently).
Re-measure a control-plane value immediately before writing it into a record: the registry can change between measurement and publication (measured here: the PLAN route was rebound mid-round).

iteration.change: Bind the checker lane's rank explicitly and assert required==served on both WRITER and CHECKER turns (this round's WRITER receipt satisfied rank 1; the R8 CHECKER did not and was not caught).
Run the 2x2 baseline matrix (clean base vs changed tree on the SAME two named tests) before attributing any failure to a change; re-validated this round.
Serialize long lanes: one sealed lane at a time, because the second dispatch shares the relay and the budget; queue the next brief instead of fanning two writers out.
Reuse the proven guarded-apply mechanism (pre-image + receipt + rollback drill + post-apply re-measure) for every canonical apply instead of authoring a new one.
For a claimed defect, name the exact fix surface (file + anchor) and the negative control that must still fail-closed; a repair without a negative control cannot be distinguished from a relaxation.

Give the checker brief an explicit, narrow allowance for fixture-created git repositories (or name the pair as expected-UNVERIFIABLE), instead of a blanket no-git rule that voids the acceptance evidence.
Have a lane write a machine-readable NONCE file as well as the prose, and have the dispatcher read that file — the nonce gate currently misses a nonce that IS emitted.
